basis: F-61: third-party services are declared in the version manifest. Final for the FS1 release (IDEA-042 GAP62-F03).

services.purpose: market data, executable quotes, approve/swap transaction building, token balances and history
services.scope: the five eligible bStocks and USDT/BNB on BNB Smart Chain (F-91, F-93)

services.purpose: official per-round decision logs (input, cot, output, orders)
services.scope: one log per decision round, signed with the wallet's AI_SEEDS_SECRET (F-99..F-101)

services.provider: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (data.sec.gov, www.sec.gov/Archives)
services.purpose: filings for the evidence assessor (8-K and periodic reports of the eligible issuers)
services.scope: submissions JSON and filing archives, contact User-Agent (LARP_SEC_USER_AGENT)

services.provider: SEC press, Federal Register (two feeds), DOJ press, European Commission press
services.purpose: official event flags for the evidence state (SHADOW_ONLY records)
services.scope: the sources enabled in config/sources/sources.v1.json; all others disabled
services.terms_ref: config/sources/sources.v1.json (rights and terms per source); IDEA-031; GAP-23/24

services.purpose: Primary evidence assessment under AIandRouting.v4 (DEV-19); deterministic verification of every claim; no trade authority (D-11)
services.scope: FS1 scored run: config/intelligence/aiand-routing.fs1.json (SHA-256 9b86c732...), US$50 frozen pacing on account larp-openai-2026, at most 60 s and 4,096 output tokens per stage (DEV-22). Complete I/O and reasoning summaries are retained. Adoption: IDEA-093 MA-01.
services.fallback: AIand Kimi K3 high and GLM-5.3 high review concurrently. An ASSESSED primary stands when reviews confirm or are unavailable; any verified disagreement or ABSTAIN blocks it. Without an ASSESSED primary, an ASSESSED reviewer is used by fixed precedence, or the assessment is UNAVAILABLE.

services.provider: AIand inference API (api.aiand.com): moonshotai/kimi-k3 / high and zai-org/glm-5.3 / high (parallel reviewers, fixed fallback precedence)
services.purpose: Independent evidence review and fallback for the OpenAI primary; reviewers receive the original evidence
services.scope: FS1 scored run, same routing file: moonshotai/kimi-k3 and zai-org/glm-5.3 at high effort, at most 90 s and 16,000 output tokens each, run concurrently (DEV-22). Requires LARP_AIAND_API_KEY.

services.provider: BNB Chain public RPC (primary) and NodeReal public RPC (backup), in that order for balance and execution reads (Isaac, 2026-10-17, IDEA-055 RPC-Q01 D1; Keegan, KG-DEC-01, 2026-10-21)
services.purpose: finalized-block wallet balance reads for the chain-balance check (IDEA-055) and the execution service's chain reads and receipts
services.scope: read-only allowlisted methods (larp/execution_live/chain.py); eth_call only for decimals() and balanceOf(wallet) on the six pinned contracts; bound into the FS1 configs by prepare_fs1 --balance-rpc-config
services.terms_ref: #92; docs/build/RPC_QUALIFICATION.md; IDEA-055 RPC-Q01 D1; docs/build/architecture-deployment.md Approved network destinations (IDEA-062)
